definition: a garland of flowers.
example_en: They put a garland of flowers around the god's neck.

definition: not orderly; unsystematic; disorderly.
example_en: The administration of that office was completely disorderly.

definition: the main or important road in a city.
example_en: The main road of the city was filled with a crowd of people.

definition: the upper part of one's face; the forehead.
example_en: Sweat was trickling down her forehead.

definition: a heavy war-club; a mace.
example: ಯೋಧನು ಗಜೆಯನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿ ಶತ್ರುವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೀಸಿದನು.
example_en: The warrior lifted the mace and swung it at the enemy.

definition: a worshipping of a ghost.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ಗಾಳಿಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಭಯ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: The villagers performed a ghost worship and got rid of their fear.

definition: a multitude, crowd, herd, etc.
example_en: There was a great crowd of people at the fair.

definition: the chief officer of a village.
example_en: The village chief led the village panchayat.

definition: an honest, truthful man.
example: ಆ ಸತ್ತಿಗ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗೆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಹೆಸರಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That honest, truthful merchant had a good name in the town.

definition: (foam) to be produced or gathered on the surface of a liquid.
example_en: Foam gathered on the surface of the boiling milk.

definition: the prowess, ability of a wrestler.
example: ಆ ಪೈಲ್ವಾನನ ಮಲ್ಲಗಂಡಿಕೆ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
example_en: That wrestler's prowess is famous throughout the whole village.

definition: to be hanging; to dangle; to move like a pendulum.
example_en: The swing was dangling in the breeze.

definition: a person descended or regarded as descended, from the ancient Hebrews of Biblical times; a jew.
example: ಆ ಪಟ್ಟಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನೇಕ ಯಹೂದ್ಯರು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Many Jews used to do business in that town.

definition: the rigid part of a whip.
example_en: The rigid handle of the whip had broken.

definition: a hallow in the ground, that is not too deep.
example_en: There was a shallow hollow in the courtyard.

definition: the plant Zingiber cassumunnar of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: The physician used the vřśa plant for the medicine.

definition: to go near or toward; to approach.
example_en: The child was approaching its mother.

definition: a person confined in prison, as for some crime; a prisoner.
example_en: That prisoner was freed by the guards.

definition: a right time or opportunity; right time for the purpose; opportune time.
example_en: They sowed the seeds looking at the opportune time.

definition: that is related to some news or information.
example_en: The newspaper's news-related article was very useful.

definition: to cause to wander.
example_en: He made that child wander about in the street.

definition: one's own military force.
example_en: The king set out for war with his own military force.

definition: wandered, roamed about aimlessly.
example_en: He wandered aimlessly in the forest, deluded.

definition: to give and receive (equivalent or similar things); to interchange; to exchange.
example_en: We exchanged books.

definition: (geom.) the segment of the x-axis included between the ordinate of a given point on a curve and the tangent at that point.
example_en: The mathematics teacher explained the subtangent of the curve.

definition: a stupid fellow.
example: ಆ ಉತುಕೋಚಿಯ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನಕ್ಕರು.
example_en: Hearing that stupid fellow's talk, everyone laughed.

definition: a man belonging to or native of Lanke (Sri Lanka).
example_en: That man from Lanka had come to India for trade.

definition: the string of a bow.
example_en: He got a new bowstring fitted to the bow.

definition: that which is opaque (?).
example: ಆ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಗಾಬಿ ಗುಣ ಬೆಳಕನ್ನು ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That stone's opaque quality blocks the light.

definition: an offspring of a donkey and a horse; a mule.
example_en: The farmer loaded sacks onto the mule.

definition: a tax or duty levied by a government to raise revenue for administration.
example_en: The government collected tax from the merchants.

definition: an eye that has rheum in it; a rheumy eye.
example: ಅವನ ಕಿಸುರುಗಣ್ಣನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ವೈದ್ಯರು ಔಷಧಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: Seeing his rheumy eye, the doctor gave him medicine.

definition: the quality or fact of being new or being related to the present time; newness.
example_en: The newness of this style attracted everyone.

definition: the condition or state of being restive due to sexual appetite and having consequent loss of sense of propriety.
example_en: His state of being blinded by lust made him lose all sense of propriety.

definition: the hissing or buzzing sound of small flying insects (as mosquitoes, small bees, etc.).
example_en: The buzzing of the bees was heard in the garden.

definition: a deep ditch made to catch someone or an animal by driving into it.
example_en: The hunters dug a deep pit trap in the forest.

definition: a broad, shallow plate of brass or copper.
example_en: They had washed and kept the brass plate in the kitchen.

definition: to cause to take a meal; to make one eat.
example_en: The grandmother lovingly fed the grandchild.

definition: an elaborate religious sacrifice.
example_en: The king had a sacrificial rite performed for progeny.

definition: that which is hidden; concealed.
example_en: A hidden secret lay concealed in that paper.

definition: an oblong, unsewn, cloth worn by girls to cover mainly the front, upper portion of their body.
example_en: The girl covered her upper body with the dhavali cloth.

definition: the act of pulling, plucking or rooting out.
example_en: The pulling out of the roots loosened the soil.

definition: a big sack of jute.
example_en: They carried the big jute sack to the warehouse.

definition: a feeling of high regard, honour or esteem; respect.
example_en: People show respect to the teachers.

definition: a source from which water oozes substantially.
example_en: Water flowed slowly from the oozing source in the well.

definition: to be anxiously or impatiently desirous of or waiting for.
example_en: He was anxiously waiting for the examination result.

definition: immediately; suddenly; at once.
example_en: He got up suddenly and ran.

definition: a vriety of small squirrel.
example_en: A small squirrel hid in the crack of the wall.

definition: kept; placed; deposited.
example_en: The jewels were kept deposited in the locker.

definition: a very patient man.
example_en: He is a very patient man whom everyone admires.

definition: the act of disappearing; a going out of sight.
example_en: As the mist cleared, the disappearance of the hill occurred (the hill went out of sight).

definition: the leguminous tree Tamarindus indica of Caesalpiniaceae family; tamarind.
example: ಪುಣಿಸೆ ಮರದ ಚಿಗುರು ಮಳೆಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The tamarind tree's new shoots grew well in the rainy season.

definition: to follow the footprints of.
example_en: That dog ran following the rabbit's footprints.

definition: a man who carries a load.
example_en: That load-bearer carried the sacks and went along.

definition: the sunlight; a ray of light of emitted by the sun.
example_en: The morning sunlight came in through the window.

definition: the act or fact of being physically joined.
example_en: Physical contact with the electric wire is dangerous.

definition: of Iran, its people or their language or culture; Iranian; Persian.
example: ಆ ಕವಿಗಳು ಪಾರಸಿ ಕಾವ್ಯ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Those poets studied the Persian poetic tradition.

definition: a very dark night covered with dark clouds of monsoon season.
example_en: The dark monsoon night became even darker with rain clouds.

definition: the act of joining together and properly.
example_en: The joining together of the two pieces of wood was firm.

definition: to be captivated; to be fascinated; to be enthralled.
example_en: He was captivated by the beauty of that flower.

definition: to plant a snare (as to catch animals, birds, etc.).
example_en: The hunter plants a snare in the forest.

definition: a black boulder.
example_en: A black boulder lay near the cave.

definition: a fiery arrow emitting sparks from its point.
example: ಯೋಧನು ಕೆಂಗೋಲನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಶತ್ರುವಿನ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಹಾರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The warrior released a fiery arrow and sent it flying toward the enemy.

definition: to get something fastened, joined, repaired with or as with stitches.
example_en: I gave the shirt to the tailor to get it stitched.

definition: a poet whose writing is inscribed on a metal plate or on the surface of stone.
example: ಆ ಶಾಸನಕವಿ ರಾಜನ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆತ್ತಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That inscription-poet had the king's achievements engraved on stone.

definition: cross grain; twined fibre.
example_en: The cross grain is clearly visible in the woodwork.

definition: a kind of herb.
example: ಈ ಔಷಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಂಬಕ ಎಂಬ ಗಿಡಮೂಲಿಕೆ ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: This medicine contains the herb called kembaka.

definition: to be perplexed, puzzled.
example_en: He was perplexed on hearing the sudden news.

definition: one of the four equal parts in to which something is divisible or divided; a quarter.
example_en: They gave a quarter of the property to the son.

definition: to become bored or wearisome.
example_en: He became wearied by the long journey.

definition: amounting to four hundred.
example_en: That book has four hundred pages.

definition: the state of being awake or having come out of sleep or sleep-like condition.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾಗ್ರ ಆಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಅವನು ಪ್ರಾರ್ಥನೆ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: As soon as he came awake in the morning, he began his prayer.

definition: an improper or disadvantageous place.
example_en: This narrow place is an improper spot for business.

definition: a king; a ruler; a monarch.
example_en: That king ruled the subjects with justice.

definition: an incapable, useless man.
example_en: He is an incapable man, he cannot do any work.

definition: the plant Daucus carota of Apiaceae family with fernlike leaves, compound umbels of white flowers.
example: ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಜ್ಜರಿ ಗಿಡಗಳು ಬಿಳಿ ಹೂ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The carrot plants in the garden had white flowers.

definition: the act of removing.
example_en: Removing that stone is not easy.

definition: a fall of rain with splashes; a splashing of rain.
example: ಕಿಟಕಿಯಿಂದ ಒಳಗೆ ಇರಿಸಲು ಬಂದು ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಒದ್ದೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Splashing rain came in through the window and wet the cloth.

definition: what will necessarily happen to any person or thing; (one's) fate; destiny.
example: ಅವನ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ವಿಧಿಕೃತ ಎಂದು ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ ಹೇಳಿದ.
example_en: The astrologer said his success was destined by fate.

definition: a thick wreath of flowers.
example_en: They put a thick flower wreath around the bride's neck.

definition: haughtiness; arrogance.
example_en: Nobody liked his haughtiness.

definition: a bunch of hairs (on the head).
example_en: The bunch of hair on her head was long.

definition: a disease, caused by a fungus (genus Candida) and characterised by the formation of milky-white lesions on the mouth, lips, and throat; thrush.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ಬಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಸಪಾಕದ ಬಿಳಿ ಕಲೆಗಳು ಕಂಡವು.
example_en: White patches of thrush were seen in the child's mouth.

definition: to communicate with a sign.
example_en: He communicated with a hand sign.

definition: each day; everyday.
example_en: She goes to the garden every day.

definition: to become estimable; to earn respectability.
example: ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ಓದಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನು ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗುರುತೆವೆಱುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: After studying hard, he will earn respectability in the town.

definition: a pile, esp. of wood, for burning a dead body on; a pyre.
example_en: They added enough firewood to the pyre.

definition: a group associated for some purpose, as to form a commercial or industrial firm.
example_en: That company opened a new factory.

definition: love; affection.
example_en: His affection was known to the whole family.

definition: (several voices) to join togther; to become unisonous.
example_en: The singers' voices joined together beautifully in unison.

definition: the creeper Tiliacora acuminata ( = T. racemosa) of Menispermaceae family).
example_en: The Tiliacora creeper has grown spreading over the fence.

definition: the headsman among sailors.
example_en: The sailors of the ship obeyed the headsman's orders.

definition: to bend; to stoop; to crouch.
example_en: The old man walked stooping in pain.

definition: to be very thirsty.
example_en: The travelers became very thirsty in the desert.

definition: a man who deceives or cheats others, esp. by pretending to be someone or something that he is not; an imposter.
example_en: The impostor cheated people by disguising himself as a monk.

definition: a stacking one above the other; a piling up.
example_en: The stacking of bricks had grown tall.

definition: a tying of both the hands on the back.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮುಷ್ಕಿ ಹಾಕಿ ಒಂದು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಬಂಧಿಸಿಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: They tied his hands behind his back and kept him bound for a night.

definition: to cut into small parts; to chop.
example_en: The cook chopped the vegetable into small pieces.

definition: a long seat, having four or more legs, for several persons to sit on; a bench.
example_en: People were sitting on the bench and talking.

definition: a dog.
example_en: The dog guards the house.

definition: the act of murmuring, whispering or talking in a very low voice.
example_en: They were talking in a murmur.

definition: an inferior class category, kind or sort.
example_en: Those goods were placed in an inferior class.

definition: the quality of attracting iron toward, as a magnet.
example_en: This metal's property of attracting iron was observed in the experiment.

definition: that which is produced by or in the clouds - a) thunder.
example_en: The sound of thunder was heard in the sky.

definition: to keep aside.
example_en: She kept that book aside.

definition: that which is of old origin; a thing made or produced long back.
example_en: This vessel is an old heirloom of our house.

definition: an abject, despicable man.
example_en: That despicable man did not help anyone.

definition: to beat - a) to defeat in a race, contest or struggle; to overcome; b) to outdo or surpass.
example: ಓಟದ ಪಂದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ತಡವಿಕ್ಕಿ ಮೊದಲಿಗನಾದನು.
example_en: In the race he defeated everyone and came first.

definition: elegant ray of light.
example_en: The elegant ray of the morning sun fell upon the hill.

definition: the red or orange coating that forms on the surface of iron when exposed to air and moisture, consisting chiefly of ferric hydroxide and ferric oxide formed by oxidation; rust.
example_en: The iron that got wet in the rain caught rust.

definition: (usu. said of selling, buying, etc.) a lot; large quantity.
example_en: The goods were sold in large quantity at the shop.

definition: a mass of new tissue growth independent of its surrounding structures, having no physiological function (which may either be benign or malignant); neoplasm.
example_en: The doctors detected a neoplasm inside the organ during the examination.

definition: a liquor distilled and sold in violation of government rules; illicit liquor.
example_en: The police caught the man selling illicit liquor.

definition: (a large number of persons) to come together for a common purpose.
example_en: The people came together and fought for freedom.

definition: a small or narrow place.
example_en: The cat hid in the narrow space between the walls.

definition: being or occurring at the middle place; intermediate.
example_en: He lives in the middle house.

definition: in the morning.
example_en: I woke up early in the morning.

definition: a young bamboo shoot (a few varieties of which are edible).
example_en: She brought young bamboo shoots from the forest for cooking.

definition: the day following tomorrow; day after tomorrow.
example_en: The exams begin the day after tomorrow.

definition: to give pleasure to; to delight.
example_en: His gift delighted the child.

definition: he who is above or not bound by, cannot be described by giving, qualities or is not limited by any particular characteristic.
example_en: The sages meditate upon the Supreme who is above all qualities.

definition: a row of lighted torches.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಪಾರಿಪಂಜು ಇಡೀ ಬೀದಿಯನ್ನು ಬೆಳಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: On the festival night, the row of lighted torches illuminated the whole street.

definition: a black stone or rock.
example_en: A black stone lay on the riverbank.

definition: a device for seizing or lifting objects, having two long arms pivoted or hinged together; a pair of tongs.
example_en: She lifted the vessel using tongs in the kitchen.

definition: any of the games of chance played for money or some other stakes; gambling.
example_en: Some people of the village gamble at night.

definition: to cause to vibrate; to shake (an object).
example_en: The wind shook the branches of the tree.

definition: to a moderate, reasonable, tolerable or acceptable extent.
example_en: He can speak Kannada to a reasonable extent.

definition: along with; together with.
example_en: The children went to the fair together with their father.

definition: to console; to comfort; to soothe; to give solace to.
example_en: My friend consoled me when I was sorrowful.

definition: a small ball-like missile, shot from a firarm; a bullet.
example_en: A bullet shot out from the gun.

definition: cleverness; deftness; dexterity; ingenuity.
example: ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಹೊಂತುಗಾರಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His dexterity in finishing the work was greater than everyone else's.

definition: the pea plant Cajanus indicus with yellow flowers, widely grown in tropical land for its edible seed; the pigeon pea plant.
example_en: The farmer sowed the pigeon pea crop in his field.

definition: to put through or sift with a sieve.
example_en: Mother sifted the flour and purified it.

definition: a place where rattans grow profusely.
example_en: Rattans grow thickly in the place where rattans abound.

definition: a worn out stone (as by constant erosion or from being used for long).
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಸಮೆಗಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother sat on the worn-out stone and told a story.

definition: a throbbing, palpitating; palpitation.
example_en: His heart's palpitation increased out of fear.

definition: (dial.) a kind of game played by boys in which two boys hold each other's left hand firmly and the third boy tries to unlock the hold.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಸಂಜೆ ಮೈದಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಳ್ಳಿ ಆಟ ಆಡಿದರು.
example_en: The children played the palli game on the ground in the evening.

definition: to engage in agriculture, as cultivating of land, raising of crops, etc.
example_en: He made a living by engaging in agriculture in the village.

definition: to disobey; to brush aside with a wilful disregard; to defy; to violate.
example: ಅವನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಉಚ್ಚಾಯಿಸಿ ತರಗತಿಯಿಂದ ಹೊರಟುಹೋದನು.
example_en: He defied the teacher's words and walked out of the class.

definition: causing dimmness or murkiness.
example_en: The pond water was murky and dirty.

definition: an armed force; an army.
example: ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಆಳ್ವಲ ಊರಿನ ಬಳಿ ಬಂದು ನಿಂತಿತು.
example_en: The enemy's army came and stood near the town.

definition: any of the variant forms of a morpheme as conditioned by position or adjoining sounds; allomorph.
example: ಒಂದೇ ರೂಪಿಮೆಯ ಉಪ ಆಕೃತಿಮಾ ರೂಪಗಳು ಸಂದರ್ಭಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: The allomorphs of a single morpheme change according to context.

definition: not having an alternative.
example_en: His decision on this matter had no alternative.

definition: to bundle or fill in a large jute bag and tie or sew the mouth.
example: ರೈತರು ಕೊಯ್ದ ಧಾನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಮೊಟ್ಟಕಟ್ಟಿ ಗಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೇರಿದರು.
example_en: The farmers bundled the harvested grain into a sack and loaded it on the cart.

definition: a house taken on rent.
example_en: They are living in a rented house in the city.

definition: the act of fondling, caressing.
example_en: Watching the children's fondling play was delightful.

definition: to become loose, slack; to lose tightness.
example_en: The hem of the old cloth became loose.

definition: a village bound with a hedge.
example_en: That hedged village was safe from enemies.

definition: any substance used for the treatment or prevention of disease; a medicine.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine for the fever.

definition: to emit light (all around).
example_en: The sun emitted light in the morning and brightened the sky.

definition: a caste the members of which are usually engaged in manufacture of salt.
example_en: People of the Uppara caste manufacture salt.

definition: with a burning sound, occurring repeatedly.
example_en: The fire burned, crackling repeatedly with a burning sound.

definition: a degraded condition.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಇಳಿಕೆ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೇಸರಪಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: Everyone felt sad seeing that family's degraded condition.

definition: a melodious, pleasing sound.
example_en: The melodious sound of her song pleased everyone.

definition: to reach the other side.
example_en: The swimmer struggled and reached the other side of the river.

definition: an adverse time; a difficult period.
example_en: People suffered hardship during that difficult period.

definition: the fact of being incapable of happening, the condition of not possible; impossibility.
example: ಅಂತಹ ಸಾಧನೆ ಅಸದಳ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಭಾವಿಸಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Everyone thought such an achievement was impossible.

definition: the tall, palm tree Cocus nucifera of Arecaceae family; coconut palm.
example_en: The coconut palm had grown tall and stood there.

definition: Śrāvaṇa, the fifth month in the Hindu lunar calendar.
example_en: A special worship takes place in the temple during the month of Shravana.

definition: a gift or contribution, as to a charitable organisation.
example_en: Everyone together collected a contribution for the association.

definition: a male runner.
example_en: The male runner ran fast on the running track.

definition: (a hole) to occur.
example_en: A hole occurred in the old vessel.

definition: to be measured.
example_en: The length of this cloth must be measured.

definition: an upholder of dishonesty, insincerity; a perfect cheat.
example: ಜನರು ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯನ್ನು ಕುಟಿಲೋದ್ಧಾರ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People used to call that merchant a perfect cheat.

definition: to shake (as grain in a winnow) repeatedly, blow the chaff by wind; to so clean; to winnow.
example_en: The farmers winnowed the paddy to separate the chaff.

definition: the biological need for water; thirst.
example_en: The desert travellers' thirst for water increased.

definition: finely ground meal of grain as wheat, rice, etc.; flour.
example_en: Mother made roti from wheat flour.

definition: to listen to; to hear.
example_en: Children should listen to the words of their elders.

definition: the act or instance of hopping; a hop.
example_en: The children hopped joyfully.

definition: advocacy of extreme political measures.
example_en: That leader supports extremist political advocacy.

definition: a display of acrobatic or gymnastic feat.
example_en: A circus performance took place in the field.

definition: to come down; to descend.
example_en: He slowly descended from the stairs.

definition: a large dam (across a river).
example_en: The government built a large dam across the river.

definition: activity engaged in for amusement or recreation; a way of spending spare time pleasantly; a play; pastime.
example_en: The children played games in the field in the evening.

definition: the groin between the belly and the thigh.
example_en: He sat down in pain after being hurt in the groin.

definition: the bony framework of the human head; skull.
example_en: A human skull was found in the old cave.

definition: the fine, soft, shiny fibre produced by silkworms to form their cocoons; silk.
example_en: The saree made of silk is very soft.

definition: a starchy foodstuff derived from the soft interior of the trunk of various palms and cycads, used in making pāyasa (a sweet in a thick liquid form), papads, puddings, etc.; sago.
example_en: Mother made a delicious payasa with sago.

definition: a secret path.
example_en: The thieves fled through the secret path.

definition: the hair growing on the cheeks and chin of men; beard.
example: ಅವನ ಆಸ್ಯಲೋಮವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಅವನು ದೊಡ್ಡವನೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Looking at his beard, one could tell that he was a grown man.

definition: a wide stretch of open field, having no buildings.
example_en: The children were playing in the wide open field.

definition: he who is ready to attack or fight.
example_en: That man ready to fight stood before the enemies.

definition: to pop - a) (a grain or corn) to burst with a short, light, and explosive sound from heating; b) to move, go, come, etc. suddenly and quickly, and usually unexpectedly.
example_en: The corn popped on the hot griddle.

definition: a particular eye-disease.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಇದು ನೇತ್ರವಾಯು ಎಂಬ ರೋಗ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said that this is an eye-disease called netravayu.

definition: the mind focused or that is concentrating on (a particular object).
example_en: He was reading the book with a mind focused entirely on it.

definition: a male parent; a father.
example_en: Her father was an elder of the village.

definition: a kind of intoxicating drink prepared using poppy seeds.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ಹಬ್ಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಘೋಟಾ ಕುಡಿದು ಸಂಭ್ರಮಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The village people drank the intoxicating poppy-seed brew at the festival and celebrated.

definition: to make stronger; to give strengh to; to stregthen.
example_en: Exercise strengthens the body.

definition: helped; favoured; assisted.
example: ಅವನ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ಉಪಕೃತನಾದ ನಾನು ಧನ್ಯವಾದ ಹೇಳಿದೆ.
example_en: Having been helped by his assistance, I expressed my thanks.

definition: a house or house-like structure built on a raft as to flat on the surface of water.
example: ನದಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ತೇಲುಮನೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a beautiful floating house on the river.

definition: the tip of the flexible striking part of a whip.
example_en: The tip of the whip's lash struck the skin and caused a wound.

definition: the state or fact of being rich; wealthiness.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಸಾವಕಾರಿಕೆ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That family's wealthiness was famous throughout the whole village.

definition: that which charred (from overheat).
example_en: The rice got charred from the stove's fire.

definition: gone under the surface of water; drowned.
example_en: The entire village went under the water in the flood.

definition: a long, almost cylindrical, percussion instrument that has leather membrane on both sides, which is very popular in Karnāṭaka system of music.
example_en: The artist played the jayi instrument skillfully.

definition: to be struck with wonder, surprise, admiration, etc; to be wonder-struck.
example_en: He was wonder-struck seeing her beauty.

definition: to take off; to remove (as dress, outer covering etc.).
example_en: He said to take off the shoes.

definition: (dial.) a natural pool or pond where water is stored or stagnated; a water tank.
example_en: The natural pool fills with water during the rainy season.

definition: rapid and heavy breathing (as from exertion); panting.
example_en: After the race, his heavy panting was loud.

definition: to deliver a blow; to strike; to beat.
example_en: That boy struck the drum loudly.

definition: lack of confidence in oneself, marked by hesitation in asserting oneself; shyness.
example: ಜನರ ಮುಂದೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಖಯಖೋಡಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had shyness in speaking in front of people.

definition: the style of the language having the characteristic of informal speech; colloquial language.
example_en: He speaks in colloquial language with his friends.

definition: to embrace tightly.
example_en: The mother embraced the child tightly and caressed it.

definition: any of an order (Blattaria) of insects with long antennae and a flat, soft body, some species of which are common household pests; a cockroach.
example_en: A cockroach was crawling in the kitchen.

definition: that which is very young or immature.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಇನ್ನೂ ಜಿಕ್ಕು, ಕೆಲಸ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That boy is still an immature one, he does not know the work.

definition: a septic state caused by scratching, punching with the nails.
example: ಅವಳ ಬೆರಳಿಗೆ ಉಗುರುನಂಜು ಬಂದು ಬಹಳ ನೋವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Her finger got a septic infection from scratching and it hurt a lot.

definition: erection of hairs on the body from joy.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಶಿಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಲೋಮಹರ್ಷ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the guru's words, the disciple's hair stood on end with joy.

definition: better or greater in some respect; higher in rank or quality; superior; excellent; estimable.
example_en: That student appeared superior to everyone else.

definition: a loud shout; an outcry.
example_en: The people raised a loud shout out of joy.

definition: any of several varieties of feldspar showing golden and red reflections from minute embedded crystals of mica, iron oxide, etc.; the sun-stone.
example: ಆ ಮುದ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಂಬಳಿಕು ಕಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಹೊಳಪುಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಕೂಡಿಸಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In that ring they had set a polished sun-stone.

definition: a game of chance played with a stake.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ಊರ ಜಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಏಟುಪಟ್ಟು ಆಡಿದರು.
example_en: The village people played the game of chance with stakes at the fair.

definition: a follower; a companion.
example_en: His follower is always with him.

definition: air in motion; wind.
example_en: The wind blew and the leaves of the trees swayed.

definition: the natural power in living beings that helps food digested; the digestive faculty.
example: ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಜಠರಾಗ್ನಿ ಬಲಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ವೈದ್ಯರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said that eating properly strengthens the digestive fire.

definition: to bend oneself or stoop slightly.
example_en: He began to stoop slightly near the door.

definition: Sīte, wife of Rāma, in epic Rāmāyaṇa, who is believed to be the daughter of mother-Earth.
example_en: Kuje refers to Sīte, the daughter of the Earth.

definition: to meditate deeply; to contemplate.
example_en: The seeker deeply contemplates the soul every day.

definition: (in comp.) gold.
example_en: She wore a gold necklace around her neck.

definition: a body of red complexion.
example_en: His red-complexioned body turned even redder in the sunlight.

definition: a good dealing or intercourse.
example: ಸದ್ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದಿಂದ ಎರಡು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸ್ನೇಹ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: Friendship grew between the two families through good dealings.

definition: a thin sphere of liquid enclosing air etc; a bubble.
example_en: The child made a bubble and played with it in the water.

definition: the act or an instance of frightening or being frightened.
example_en: Hearing the teacher's stern reprimand, the disciple was frightened.

definition: to become impure; to be adulterated, polluted or defiled.
example_en: The water became polluted due to the filth.

definition: a case for carrying or holding arrows; a quiver.
example_en: The hunter kept the arrows in the quiver.

definition: any of a set of hard, bonelike structures set in the jaws of most vertebrates that consists typically of a sensitive, vascular pulp surrounded by dentin and coated on the crown with enamel and on the root with cementum, and used for biting, tearing, chewing, and also as weapons of attack or defence; a tooth.
example_en: The child's first tooth appeared today.

definition: the plant Hernandia peltata of Hernandiacae family.
example_en: The Hernandia peltata plant grows on the seashore.

definition: not civilised; savage; rude; uncultured.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡು ಜನಾಂಗ ಇನ್ನೂ ನಾಗರಿಕತೆ ಕಂಡಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That savage tribe has still not seen civilization.

definition: an ill-fated, unlucky man.
example_en: That unlucky man suffered hardship all his life.

definition: excessive and violent anger; fury; rage.
example: ಆ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ವಿಕೋಪ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that remark, a violent fury came over him.

definition: not letting light pass through; not transparent or translucent; opaque.
example: ಈ ಗಾಜು ಅಪಾರದರ್ಶಕವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಒಳಗೆ ಏನೂ ಕಾಣಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: This glass is opaque and nothing can be seen inside.

definition: that which excites thirst or appetite; a small portion of a tasty food or drink that excites a desire for more food; an appetizer as a relish, condiment etc.
example_en: They served pickle as an appetizer with the meal.

definition: morally bad or wrong; acting with an evil intent; depraved.
example_en: No one trusts that depraved man.

definition: great speed or velocity.
example_en: The car sped down the highway at great velocity.

definition: Viṣṇu, (or Křṣṇa).
example_en: The devotees sang the hymn of Vishnu.

definition: the act or sound of laughing.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಕ್ಖಟದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖವಿದೆ.
example_en: That old text has a mention of the sound of laughing.

definition: a disease of the testicles.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮುಷ್ಟಿಶೂಲೆ ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said he has a disease of the testicles.

definition: an internal quarrel or conflict within a group of people.
example_en: The internal conflict within the party caused the defeat in the election.

definition: want of digestion.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅಱವೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Indigestion resulted from eating too much food at night.

definition: occurring, happening, made each day; daily; diurnal.
example: ಅವನು ದೈನಿಕ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಓದುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He reads the daily newspaper every morning.

definition: to move from one place to another (usu. continuously); to wander; to roam.
example_en: During the summer vacation, he wandered from town to town.

definition: to watch and wait for right opportunity.
example_en: He was watching and waiting for the right opportunity.

definition: a heinous, abominable murder.
example_en: That heinous murder shook the entire city.

definition: to take, extract the juice from.
example_en: The workers extracted the juice from the sugarcane.

definition: any of various small, strong, two-wheeled vehicles drawn by an ox or usu. two oxen.
example_en: The chakkaḍi moved slowly along the village road.

definition: a bird, akin to crow, resembling the pheasant; a crow-pheasant.
example_en: The crow-pheasant is a black-coloured bird.

definition: the backside of the palm.
example: ಬಿಸಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆ ಮುಟ್ಟಿದಾಗ ಅವಳ ಹೆಡಗೈ ಸುಟ್ಟುಹೋಯಿತು.
example_en: The back of her palm got burnt when she touched the hot vessel.

definition: to be ruined; to come to ruin.
example_en: Because of his extravagance the whole family came to ruin.

definition: a wooden board with two rows of seven hollows, used to play on with cowries or tamarind seeds.
example_en: The children played with cowries on the pantamane board.

definition: consisting fully of nectar; ambrosial; full of nectar.
example_en: The guru's words sounded as if full of nectar.

definition: the act of killing; slaughter.
example_en: The slaughter of animals is banned in that village.

definition: having projected teeth.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯ ದಂತುರ ಬಾಯಿ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That animal's mouth with projecting teeth was frightening.

definition: that which degenerates the body.
example_en: That medicine turned out to be something that degenerates the body.

definition: the fact of being associated; association.
example_en: The association of those two is very old.

definition: a violent or a series of violent actions inflicting injuries, damage; violence.
example_en: Violence broke out in the town due to the riot.

definition: an upward slope of ground; acclivity.
example_en: A small acclivity appeared all along the path.

definition: unfavourable estimation; bad reputation; disgrace.
example_en: His disgrace spread everywhere.

definition: a kind of drama played wearing masks and other disguises; a masquerade.
example_en: They performed a masquerade at the festival.

definition: (a series of pictures or events) to run in the mind of a sleeping person.
example: ಮಲಗಿದ ಮಗುವಿನ ಕನಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಘಟನೆಗಳು ಕನಂಬರಿದವು.
example_en: Old events ran through the sleeping child's dream.

definition: the place, region that is behind some object.
example_en: There was an old temple in the region behind that hill.

definition: the part of a palace or house reserved for the residence of women.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಮನೆಯ ಝನಾನಾ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಯಾರೂ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one entered the women's quarters of the old house.

definition: the act or process of moving; movement.
example_en: That bird's movement was very swift.

definition: that is soiled; dirty; unclean; putrid; rotten.
example_en: Grandmother put the dirty clothes to wash.

definition: to spread (one's) plumage (as a peacock while dancing).
example_en: A peacock in the garden was spreading its plumage and dancing.

definition: a low voice.
example_en: He spoke in a low voice.

definition: a metal container, usu. rectangular, with a hinged or detachable lid, for keeping things; a box.
example_en: She kept the jewellery in the box.

definition: to feel envy towards, at or because of otherś wellbeing, good fortune, wealth etc. as one's eyesore; to envy.
example_en: Seeing the neighbor's wealth, he felt envious.

definition: the grey colour.
example: ಮೋಡಗಳಿಗೆ ದೂಸರ ಬಣ್ಣ ಬಂದಾಗ ಮಳೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: When the clouds take on a grey colour, it rains.

definition: to be compressed; to become reduced in volume.
example_en: Due to pressure, the ball got compressed and became flat.

definition: a round, plump face.
example_en: The child's round, plump face attracts onlookers.

definition: to cause to vex, molest.
example: ಅವನು ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಬಂದು ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಅಂಡಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He kept coming again and again and vexed me.

definition: absence of arrogance, haughtiness, etc.; humility.
example_en: That king's freedom from arrogance was dear to his subjects.

definition: a counting, multiplying etc. in the mind (without working on a paper or board or without using calculaor, computer, etc.).
example_en: He solved even the difficult sum through mental calculation.

definition: a clear, shrill sound made by whistling or blowing a whistle.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಶಿಳ್ಳಿ ಕೇಳಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಸಾಲಾಗಿ ನಿಂತರು.
example_en: Hearing the teacher's whistle, the students stood in a line.

definition: a bunch of musical notes stringed together in different combinations.
example_en: He played a beautiful bunch of musical notes on the veena.

definition: the aloe plant Aloe barbadensis of Liliaceae family; Indian aloe.
example_en: He uses the aloe leaf as medicine.

definition: a person unable to read and write; an illeterate person.
example_en: Though he was an illiterate person, he was clever.

definition: the sensation of itching.
example_en: There was itching on the back due to sweat.

definition: a man who is not under the control of any other person or any arbitrary control; a free man.
example_en: He lived as a free man belonging to no one.

definition: a cowrie used among premitives as money.
example_en: In ancient times the cowrie was a medium of exchange.

definition: a great ambition, aspiration.
example_en: Becoming the leader of the country is her great ambition.

definition: a particular kindof yōgic conditioning of the body against aging, disease, injury etc.
example_en: A yogi who has attained bodily perfection has no fear of old age.

definition: (a omen) to foretell.
example_en: The astrologer foretold by observing the position of the planets.

definition: to say; to speak; to utter (a word); to pronounce.
example_en: He spoke the truth and said it aloud.

definition: a man who dresses himself in imitation of Europeans.
example_en: That fop dressed himself in imitation of Europeans.

definition: a deranged state of the mind usually occurring as a specific disorder (as schizophrenia) and usually excluding such states as mental retardation, psychoneurosis, and various character disorders; a mental disorder; insanity.
example_en: That boy was behaving as if seized by insanity.

definition: having a relatively great height; of more than average stature.
example_en: That tree had grown to more than average height.

definition: ecstasy of joy; overpowering joy.
example: ಮಗನ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಕೇಳಿ ತಂದೆಗೆ ನಲವುಮತ್ತು ಆವರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The father was overwhelmed with ecstatic joy hearing his son's success.

definition: guarded; protected; saved.
example_en: That child remained fully protected.

definition: the enlarged, hollow part of the pistil or gynoecium, containing ovules; the ovary in a flower.
example_en: Seeds develop in the ovary of the flower.

definition: a boat fitted with a mast.
example_en: The fishermen set out to sea in the masted boat.

definition: the land along the edge of a sea, lake, river, etc.; the shore; a bank.
example_en: The fishermen returned to the shore in the evening.

definition: the leader of the opposition party.
example_en: In the assembly, the opposition leader spoke against the government.

definition: to repair a dent or dents in a surface; to tinker.
example: ಬಡಗಿ ಕಾರಿನ ಬಾಗಿಲಿನ ಗುಳಿಯನ್ನು ನಗ್ಗೆತ್ತು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The carpenter repaired the dent in the car door.

definition: to cut; to sever; to break.
example_en: He cut the rope with a sword.

definition: to lose or to be deprived of courage.
example_en: After the defeat, he was losing his courage.

definition: the dignity and style of a sovereign.
example_en: His royal dignity astonished everyone.

definition: to swell (too much).
example_en: Prices swelled too much and became hard on the people.

definition: a liberal, generous man.
example: ಆ ದಿಲ್ದಾರು ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಉದಾರವಾಗಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That generous man used to help the poor liberally.

definition: to cause to scream or shout aloud.
example_en: The boys made each other shout aloud in the game and laughed.

definition: to see both sides (of the same thing).
example_en: The judge saw both sides of the case.

definition: any of the storeys above the ground floor of a building; upstairs.
example_en: They are sleeping upstairs.

definition: an angle of 90 degrees; angle made by the meeting of two straight lines perpendicular to each other; a right angle.
example_en: The walls meet each other at a right angle.

definition: a utensil with a rough surface on which to grate coconut, vegetables, etc.; a grater.
example_en: She grated coconut on the grater.

definition: a young man.
example_en: That young man has newly come to the village.

definition: a drafting ox.
example_en: The farmer harnessed the drafting ox to the cart.

definition: the act of burying or cremating the body of a dead person.
example_en: The funeral rites were performed the next morning.

definition: to tear or dig with the nails or claws; to scratch.
example_en: The cat scratched the bark of the tree.

definition: a belt or band for tying round the waist.
example_en: She tied a belt round her waist.

definition: a sport-quarrel; a lovers' quarrel.
example: ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಅಣುಗಗಲಹ ನಡೆದು ಸಮಾಧಾನವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A small lovers' quarrel took place between the two and then they made up.

definition: a honey-bee.
example_en: The honey-bee flew around the beehive.

definition: the act of emitting or discharging forcefully (a liquid in continuous drops).
example_en: The child drank the milk in forceful gulps.

definition: to get selected; to be chosen; to be elected.
example_en: He got elected in the election.

definition: to select; to choose.
example: ಆ ಗುಡ್ಡದ ಎತ್ತು ಸಾವಿರ ಮೀಟರ್ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The height of that hill is a thousand metres.

definition: going upto, reaching the bottom.
example_en: The rainwater filled the well right down to the bottom.

definition: to lose one's course.
example_en: They lost their course in the night's darkness and wandered about.

definition: the possibility or chance of one's marriage.
example: ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ ಅವಳ ಕಂಕಣಪ್ರಾಪ್ತಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The astrologer predicted about her chance of marriage.

definition: not proper and fitting; unseemly; morally offensive; obscene; indecent.
example_en: No one tolerated his indecent words.

definition: a kind of sweet or spicy pudding cooked in steam.
example_en: Grandfather liked to eat steamed pudding during the rainy season.

definition: blown or blowing (as wind).
example_en: A blowing wind was gusting from the east.

definition: a building, usu. with cells, where convicted criminals, esp. those serving longer sentences, are confined; a prison; a jail.
example_en: The criminal was confined in the jail.

definition: to come out of sleep or a state similar to sleep, stupor, trance etc.; to wake up.
example_en: The child woke up at the sound of the bell.

definition: the duration of one's life; life-time.
example_en: His lifetime was filled with hardships.

definition: Brahminee kite (Haliastur indus), a accipitrine bird with long, pointed wings, forked tail and white neck.
